professionalSummary: Experienced project manager with a proven track record of leading finance and regulatory change initiatives, including the migration of quarterly solvency returns from spreadsheets to a vendor reporting platform. Demonstrated ability to maintain integrated project plans, manage RAID logs, prepare steering committee packs, coordinate user acceptance testing, and track vendor delivery milestones.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review is required to assess fit for the role.

evidence.text: Kept the integrated plan and RAID log for moving Marlow Mutual Insurance's quarterly solvency returns from spreadsheets to a vendor reporting platform, from mobilisation in March 2022 to closure in August 2023.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of plan and RAID log maintenance.

evidence.text: Wrote the monthly steering committee pack (status, milestones, top risks, decisions needed) and issued minutes with numbered actions after each meeting.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of steering committee pack preparation and action recording.

evidence.text: Coordinated three rounds of user acceptance testing with the finance reporting team, triaging 212 defects in the test management tool and chairing the daily defect call during each round.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of UAT coordination and defect tracking.

evidence.text: Work sample: the project closure slide pack. The milestone and defect slides match the plan. The 'Benefits' slide is a single headline, 'Manual reconciliation effort down 60%, saving £180k a year', with no table, measurement period or reference to the business case.
evidence.notes: Benefits claim present but lacks baseline comparison and business case reference.

missingEvidence: Evidence that realised benefits were measured against the baseline in the approved business case at project closure.

evidence.text: Tracked the vendor's statement-of-work milestones, checking each deliverable against its acceptance criteria before finance released the milestone payment.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of vendor milestone management.

supportedClaims.claim: Maintained an integrated project plan and RAID log for the solvency returns migration.
supportedClaims.witness: Kept the integrated plan and RAID log for moving Marlow Mutual Insurance's quarterly solvency returns from spreadsheets to a vendor reporting platform, from mobilisation in March 2022 to closure in August 2023.

supportedClaims.claim: Prepared monthly steering committee packs and recorded decisions and actions.
supportedClaims.witness: Wrote the monthly steering committee pack (status, milestones, top risks, decisions needed) and issued minutes with numbered actions after each meeting.

supportedClaims.claim: Coordinated user acceptance testing with finance users and tracked defects to closure.
supportedClaims.witness: Coordinated three rounds of user acceptance testing with the finance reporting team, triaging 212 defects in the test management tool and chairing the daily defect call during each round.

supportedClaims.claim: Tracked vendor delivery milestones against a statement of work.
supportedClaims.witness: Tracked the vendor's statement-of-work milestones, checking each deliverable against its acceptance criteria before finance released the milestone payment.

missingEvidenceGaps.gap: No evidence that realised benefits were measured against the baseline in the approved business case at project closure.

interviewSignalRisks.text: Reference check summary: the insurer's former finance change director confirmed in writing that the candidate was project manager for the solvency reporting project from March 2022 to August 2023 and attended every steering committee.
interviewSignalRisks.recommendedHandling: Verify the reference details and confirm attendance records.

interviewSignalRisks.text: HR verification note: the candidate's PRINCE2 Practitioner certificate was checked on the accrediting body's successful-candidate register and is current.
interviewSignalRisks.recommendedHandling: Confirm the certificate validity and relevance to the role.

followUpQuestions.question: Can you provide documentation or a report that shows the realised benefits were measured against the baseline in the approved business case at project closure?
followUpQuestions.evidenceTarget: Baseline comparison and business case reference.

humanReviewChecklist: Verify that the benefits claim meets the requirement for baseline measurement.
Confirm that the vendor milestone tracking aligns with the statement of work.
Ensure that the steering committee pack preparation includes decision recording.
hiringEvidencePacket.auditSummary: The candidate has documented experience aligning with most project management requirements for the role, except for the benefit measurement against the baseline, which requires further evidence. No protected characteristics are inferred. Human review is needed to assess the missing benefit measurement evidence and overall fit.
limitations: Evidence is limited to the provided resume and work sample; no external project documentation was supplied.
